authorization: Design artifacts only; no active role, policy, runtime or production changes. No further delegation.
decisions: Preserve existing roles and exact standing/task authorization; do not add per-step approvals for bounded low-risk operations.
Treat proposed policy text as design, not execution authority; host restrictions remain upper bounds.
Protect policy, grants and execution credentials outside agent-writable stores before claiming enforcement.
Use allow/deny/require_review, low/medium/high/critical and observe/enforce shared contract values.
Require_review is not executable: action_approval binds the original review decision; a final allow references review_target_digest and approval_digests to avoid circular signing dependencies.
Use P0 advisory observe, P1 development/CI gates with bypass caveat, P2 isolated explicitly authorized pilot and P3 monitoring/calibration/controlled expansion.
Do not invent applicable legislation or safety percentages; map actual requirements with human accountable owners.
Zero observed violations in mandatory catastrophic negative tests is a finite release condition, not a guarantee of zero real-world risk.
